case_study.title: King Menes: Absolute Character Consistency
case_study.challenge: Maintaining identity and attire across diverse environments (Palace, Battlefield, Temple).
case_study.solution: Developed a Master Character Sheet and enforced a Face-Verification Loop to eliminate visual drift.
case_study.result: A believable and consistent protagonist, enabling a high-quality narrative arc.

case_study.title: Titanic 1912: Cinematic Reconstruction
case_study.challenge: Recreating the RMS Titanic's final hours with historical accuracy and emotional weight.
case_study.solution: Used AI-generated period-accurate environments, procedural crowd simulation, and a custom cold-color LUT for the North Atlantic.
case_study.result: A haunting, historically grounded visualization of the Titanic's last moments.

case_study.title: Mary Celeste: Visual Forensics
case_study.challenge: Reconstructing a 19th-century ghost ship with zero surviving witnesses or photographs.
case_study.solution: Combined historical blueprints, maritime archaeology references, and AI-driven material simulation for wood, rope, and sailcloth.
case_study.result: A forensically plausible reconstruction that balances mystery with historical rigor.

case_study.title: Dawn of Civilization: AI Archaeology
case_study.challenge: Visualizing 6,000-year-old Mesopotamian cities with no standing architecture.
case_study.solution: Collaborated with archaeologists to build reference libraries from excavation data, then used AI to extrapolate complete urban environments with procedural population.
case_study.result: The first AI-driven visualization of Uruk and Eridu at their peak, peer-reviewed for academic plausibility.

case_study.title: Chernobyl: Atmospheric Oppression
case_study.challenge: Creating a consistent 'radioactive haze' and oppressive atmosphere across a devastated city.
case_study.solution: Implemented an Atmospheric Engineering strategy using Volumetric Fog and a custom desaturated color LUT, paired with procedurally synthesized low-frequency drones.
case_study.result: A visually cohesive and emotionally heavy environment that evokes fear and tension.

case_study.title: Tunguska 1908: The Day the Forest Fell
case_study.challenge: Depicting the largest impact event in recorded history with no crater and zero photographs.
case_study.solution: Simulated airburst physics with procedural tree-fall patterns, combined with period-accurate Siberian taiga biome and witness testimony audio reconstruction.
case_study.result: A scientifically grounded visualization of the Tunguska event, used in educational contexts.

case_study.title: Dyatlov Pass: Nine Hikers, Zero Answers
case_study.challenge: Visualizing a 1959 Soviet mystery with contradictory evidence and no survivors.
case_study.solution: Created a non-linear narrative structure using AI-generated reenactments of each leading theory (avalanche, katabatic wind, military test), unified by a consistent Ural Mountains environment.
case_study.result: An investigative documentary that presents evidence without prescribing conclusions.

case_study.title: Roanoke: The Lost Colony
case_study.challenge: Reconstructing a 1587 English settlement that vanished leaving only the word 'CROATOAN' carved in a post.
case_study.solution: Built a dual-timeline visualization: the 1587 settlement using primary source descriptions, and a modern archaeological overlay showing current excavation sites.
case_study.result: A haunting dual-perspective documentary bridging 400 years of mystery.

case_study.title: Thoth: Architecture of the Divine
case_study.challenge: Reconstructing the lost Library of Thoth with zero archaeological remains — only textual references.
case_study.solution: Synthesized Ptolemaic architectural vocabulary with Hermetic symbolism, using AI to generate structurally plausible temple complexes that encode mathematical and astronomical alignments.
case_study.result: A speculative but academically informed visualization of the 'lost library' as a functioning cosmological instrument.

case_study.title: The Sphinx: Absolute Visual Consistency
case_study.challenge: Maintaining architectural precision and 4K detail during camera movement.
case_study.solution: Implemented Identity Lock with a 3-angle master reference and a custom Golden Hour color grade.
case_study.result: Cinematic realism with 0% visual drift across shots.

case_study.title: Minecraft Narrative: Block-by-Block Storytelling
case_study.challenge: Creating a compelling narrative within Minecraft's procedural, block-based aesthetic.
case_study.solution: Developed a hybrid pipeline: hand-built key locations for story beats, AI-assisted terrain generation for scale, and custom resource packs for cinematic lighting and camera work.
case_study.result: A narrative series that transcends the 'gameplay video' genre — cinematic storytelling in a voxel world.

case_study.title: Branded AI Ads: Product Meets Innovation
case_study.challenge: Producing AI-generated advertisements that maintain brand identity while pushing visual boundaries.
case_study.solution: Built a Brand Identity Lock system: master brand guidelines encoded as LoRA weights, color palette enforcement via post-processing LUTs, and automated compliance checking against brand safety rules.
case_study.result: A scalable branded content pipeline delivering on-brand AI videos at 10x traditional speed.
